name: ps-scan-run-unreadable-files
body: run reads every claimed file's bytes before module assignment, warns about and drops a file it cannot read, and holds all bytes until the scan ends. Limits: an unreadable file is neither emitted nor claimable, so a manifest naming it claims nothing; memory grows with the size of the claimed tree. Upgrade by reading the .psd1 files first and the rest one at a time when large trees make memory a concern.
